title: Part III: The Use of the Whole Book for Barrels
author: Johannes Kepler
full_title: Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum, inprimis Austriaci, figurae omnium aptissimae; et usus in eo virgae cubicae compendiosissimus et plane singularis. Accessit stereometriae Archimedeae supplementum
source: The third and last part of Kepler's *Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum* (Linz: Johannes Planck, at the author's expense, 1615).
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-11051) of the copy in the ETH-Bibliothek, Zürich (Rar 356: 1 q), on e-rara.
summary: Practical rules: which barrels to buy, how to gauge barrels of any shape with a plain rod, how to trace the curve of the staves with an instrument, and how to find how much wine has been drawn from a barrel lying on its side, with a table of circular segments. Kepler ends with a toast.
